title: Sir Alec Guinness
description: Sir Alec Guinness, Obi-Wan "Ben" Kenobi to a generation of fans, dashed off a simple and elegant 1982 sketch (front), depicting himself in one of his shortest—but most lucrative—roles. Guinness added a certain dignity and sophistication to the cast, providing Twentieth Century-Fox with a degree of comfort; since no one had heard of any of the other actors. (Collection of William Plumb.)
